title: Kiwi (bird)
blurb: Kiwi are flightless birds endemic to New Zealand of the order Apterygiformes. The five extant species fall into the family Apterygidae and genus Apteryx.
facts: Approximately the size of a domestic chicken, kiwi are the smallest ratites.
